name: River Pull

card.plain: The river tugs back: when this special hits, your foe is pulled one step closer to you.
card.frames: Pulls the opponent one step closer on hit

notes: 'One step' distance is not defined in the GDD; value 1 = one step, unit distance is an open question for the designer.
